teacher: UniFault Tiny official public checkpoint pretrain-epoch=1.ckpt
paper_100ms: Split each 4000 Hz, one-second XYZ packet into ten nonoverlapping 400-sample chunks. Polyphase resample each chunk 64/25 to 1024 points. This matches paper duration/length but is upsampling because local bandwidth is lower; it creates no new physical bandwidth.
code_native1024: Sensitivity to code example: three nonoverlapping 1024-sample chunks per second, 0.256 seconds per chunk, last 928 samples omitted. No resampling.
normalization: Per-axis train-recording-only min-max, applied after resampling/chunking; no clipping, no per-test fitting, no demeaning. Match official normalization formula denominator max-min+1e-6. Numerical bfloat16->float32 roundtrip matches public data loader.
features: Official 128-dimensional Transformer token outputs averaged over tokens, three axes and chunks to one vector per existing one-second contact window. Separate axis/chunk outputs retained.
pretrained_backbone: Frozen, eval mode; no local gradient training. Full checkpoint strict load including 16-way head; semantic mapping of 16 classes not published and therefore no native four-class accuracy asserted.
contact_readout: Per-fold StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=2000,solver=lbfgs,class_weight=balanced,random_state=42). Same readout recipe as prior RotLLM experiment. No hyperparameter or variant selection on held-out recordings.
scope: Previously inspected development data; 8 recordings, one physical specimen per fault category. Only 58 main contact windows. Not blind evaluation or statistical proof of universality.
third_teacher_principle: Architecture/source diversity check, not a claim of rich fault knowledge by itself.
expected_output_sign: Unconstrained signed LayerNorm features; radar output must not be forced through ReLU when targeting this teacher.
legacy_weights: No writes to old BearLLM or RotLLM weights, features, inputs or reports. All new outputs under teachers/.
run_environment: m2vllm, torch inference, CPU threads 2, GPU0
